title: Fronting và topicalisation
learningObjectiveVi: Đưa bổ ngữ hoặc trạng ngữ lên đầu câu để nối chủ đề hoặc tạo đối lập có kiểm soát.
learningObjectiveEn: Front complements or adjuncts to manage topic continuity or controlled contrast.

morphologyNotes: Fronting must have a clear discourse motivation and preserve grammatical relations in the remaining clause.

usageConstraints: The structure must be motivated by meaning, information flow, stance, or register rather than complexity alone.

rules.description: Fronting must have a clear discourse motivation and preserve grammatical relations in the remaining clause.
